title: ONC ERDAPP with R
text:
Demonstration of how to use the rerddap package to access data from the Ocean Networks Canada ERDDAP server. A minimal translation from https://github.com/oceanhackweek/ohw-tutorials/blob/OHW26/01-Tue/DataAccess/PartI_ERDDAP_Tutorial.ipynb

library(rerddap)
library(tidyverse)

── Attaching core tidyverse packages ──────────────────────── tidyverse 2.0.0 ──
✔ dplyr     1.2.1     ✔ readr     2.2.0
✔ forcats   1.0.1     ✔ stringr   1.6.0
✔ ggplot2   4.0.3     ✔ tibble    3.3.1
✔ lubridate 1.9.5     ✔ tidyr     1.3.2
✔ purrr     1.2.2     
── Conflicts ────────────────────────────────────────── tidyverse_conflicts() ──
✖ dplyr::filter() masks stats::filter()
✖ dplyr::lag()    masks stats::lag()
ℹ Use the conflicted package (<http://conflicted.r-lib.org/>) to force all conflicts to become errors

library(patchwork)


time_series_length <- 14 # in days. note ERDDAP server is slow, which is why we are limiting to 14 days for now.
start_time <- Sys.time() - time_series_length * 24 * 3600
query_vars <- c(
  'time',
  'temperature',
  'oxygen_corrected',
  'oxygen_uncorrected',
  'latitude',
  'longitude',
  'depth'
)

base_url <- 'https://dap.oceannetworks.ca/erddap'

dataset_id <- 'scalar_1217325'


info(dataset_id, url = base_url)

<ERDDAP(TM) info> scalar_1217325 
 Base URL: https://dap.oceannetworks.ca/erddap 
 Dataset Type: tabledap 
 Variables:  
     depth: 
         Range: 113.0, 113.0 
         Units: m 
     latitude: 
         Range: 49.153883, 49.153883 
         Units: degrees_north 
     longitude: 
         Range: -124.80255, -124.80255 
         Units: degrees_east 
     oxygen_corrected: 
         Units: ml/l 
     oxygen_uncorrected: 
         Units: ml/l 
     temperature: 
         Units: K 
     time: 
         Range: 1.7491443E9, NaN 
         Units: seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z 
     timeseries_id: 
         Range: scalar_1217325
scalar_1217325 



data <- tabledap(
  info(dataset_id, url = base_url),
  paste0("time>=", format(start_time, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")),
  fields = query_vars,
  url = base_url
)

info() output passed to x; setting base url to: https://dap.oceannetworks.ca/erddap



temp_plot <- data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = time, y = temperature)) +
  geom_line(colour = "red") +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Temperature at depth ", unique(data$depth), "m"),
    x = "Time",
    y = "Temperature (°C)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

oxy_plot <- data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = time, y = oxygen_corrected)) +
  geom_line(colour = "blue") +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Corrected Oxygen at depth ", unique(data$depth), "m"),
    x = "Time",
    y = "Oxygen (µmol/kg)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

temp_plot / oxy_plot
